blocks.text: Transcription is the first step of gene expression, in which a complementary RNA is made from DNA. Only one strand of the DNA, the template strand, is transcribed, and the mRNA is complementary to it. The other strand is the coding strand, because it has the same sequence as the mRNA except that it has T where the mRNA has U.

blocks.title: For information
blocks.text: The template strand is also called the antisense (-) strand, and the coding strand the sense (+) strand.
